files.role: Package metadata and dependency declaration for label_engine
Container image build: copies platform_packages from repo root context, installs dependencies, runs uvicorn on port 8000
Docker Compose service definition: binds 127.0.0.1:8050:8000, atlas-net external network, ATLAS_PG_* env vars, log volume mount
FastAPI application entrypoint: creates app, adds CORS middleware, installs platform_errorhandling handlers, mounts all routers at /api prefix, registers startup event
Connection pool management and schema initialisation. Owns labels schema DDL. Provides get_db context manager.

methods.name: init_pool
methods.purpose: Initialise the psycopg2 SimpleConnectionPool using ATLAS_PG_* environment variables

methods.name: init_schema
methods.purpose: Execute schema.sql idempotently to create labels schema tables; falls back to inline DDL if file is absent

methods.name: get_db
methods.purpose: Context manager that checks out a connection from the pool and returns it on exit; rolls back on exception

private_objects.name: _build_url
private_objects.purpose: Construct DSN string from ATLAS_PG_* env vars or DATABASE_URL override

private_objects.name: _run_inline_ddl
private_objects.purpose: Inline DDL fallback — must be kept in sync with 20_Data/schema.sql

files.role: Pydantic models for all request bodies and response envelopes. These are the shared_views provided by this component.

public_objects.name: ObjectLabelRecord
public_objects.fields: object_id: str, label_id: str, label_name: str, attached_at: str

public_objects.name: GroupItem
public_objects.fields: id: str, primary_label: str | None, labels: list[str]

files.role: All label business logic. Receives a db connection; performs SQL; returns typed model instances. No HTTP concerns.

methods.name: search_labels
methods.purpose: Return labels whose name starts with q (case-insensitive prefix match). Empty q returns all labels.

methods.name: create_label
methods.purpose: Insert a new label with the given name and return the created record. Caller must have validated name is non-empty.

methods.name: attach_label
methods.purpose: Resolve or create label by name, then INSERT attachment with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. Return the ObjectLabelRecord for the (object_id, label_id) pair.

methods.name: remove_label
methods.purpose: Delete the (object_id, label_id) attachment row. Raises LabelEngineError with code ATTACHMENT_NOT_FOUND if the row does not exist.

methods.name: get_labels_for_object
methods.purpose: Return all labels for the given object ordered by attached_at ASC, label_id ASC.

methods.name: get_grouped_objects
methods.purpose: Query all object_ids of the given type from the labels schema, determine primary label per object (MIN attached_at, ties by label_id ASC), assemble GroupedObjectsResponse with groups sorted alphabetically and Unlabeled last.

public_objects.name: LabelEngineError
public_objects.fields: code: str, message: str, status: int

private_objects.name: _resolve_or_create_label
private_objects.purpose: Exact name lookup (case-insensitive) then INSERT if absent. Returns label_id. Used internally by attach_label only.

files.role: HTTP routes for label search and creation. Mounts at /api via main.py.

private_objects.name: search_labels
private_objects.purpose: GET /api/labels handler — validates q param, calls LabelService.search_labels, returns LabelSearchResponse

private_objects.name: create_label
private_objects.purpose: POST /api/labels handler — validates name via CreateLabelRequest, calls LabelService.create_label, returns LabelRecord; raises 422 on LABEL_NAME_EMPTY

files.role: HTTP routes for label attachment and retrieval on objects. Mounts at /api via main.py.

private_objects.name: attach_label
private_objects.purpose: POST /api/objects/{object_id}/labels handler — calls LabelService.attach_label, returns ObjectLabelRecord

private_objects.name: remove_label
private_objects.purpose: DELETE /api/objects/{object_id}/labels/{label_id} handler — calls LabelService.remove_label; returns 404 on ATTACHMENT_NOT_FOUND

private_objects.name: get_object_labels
private_objects.purpose: GET /api/objects/{object_id}/labels handler — calls LabelService.get_labels_for_object, returns ObjectLabelsResponse

files.role: HTTP route for grouped object query. Mounts at /api via main.py.

private_objects.name: get_grouped_objects
private_objects.purpose: GET /api/groups handler — requires object_type query param (422 OBJECT_TYPE_REQUIRED if absent), calls LabelService.get_grouped_objects, returns GroupedObjectsResponse
